name: ReconstructConeBeamFDK
label: Cone-Beam FDK
description:
Reconstruct cone-beam X-ray CT projections (lab and industrial scanners with a point source and a flat-panel detector) with the Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) algorithm.

The input must be line integrals (use Flat/Dark Field Correction or Intensity to Line Integrals first). Each projection is an image in the x-y plane, with x parallel to the rotation axis; the projection angles are the tilt angles, in degrees. Scans of 360 degrees use full-scan weights; shorter scans (at least 180 degrees plus the fan angle) use Parker short-scan weights.

The geometry comes from the data when its file reader stored the scanner geometry (From the Data), or is a circular orbit described below, or a measured per-projection geometry loaded from a text file with one row of 12 numbers per projection (source, detector centre, detector u step, detector v step; the ASTRA cone_vec layout).

The output volume has x along the rotation axis and voxel spacing in the same units as the distances.

parameters.name: geometry_source
parameters.label: Geometry
parameters.description: From the Data uses the scanner geometry stored with the projections by their file reader (Nikon, ZEISS, Waygate, Bruker and similar). Otherwise enter a circular orbit, or load per-projection vectors.

parameters.name: sod
parameters.label: Source to Rotation Axis Distance
parameters.description: Distance from the X-ray source to the rotation axis (SOD), in mm or any length unit used consistently.

parameters.name: sdd
parameters.label: Source to Detector Distance
parameters.description: Distance from the X-ray source to the detector (SDD).

parameters.name: pixel_size
parameters.label: Detector Pixel Size
parameters.description: Detector pixel pitch (as binned), in the same unit as the distances.

parameters.name: offset_u
parameters.label: Horizontal Detector Offset (pixels)
parameters.description: Where the central ray, through the rotation axis and perpendicular to the detector, hits the detector, in pixels from the detector centre across the rotation axis (along y). Use it to correct an off-centre rotation axis.

parameters.name: offset_v
parameters.label: Vertical Detector Offset (pixels)
parameters.description: Where the central ray hits the detector, in pixels from the detector centre along the rotation axis (along x).

parameters.name: clockwise
parameters.label: Reverse Rotation Direction
parameters.description: Turn this on if the reconstruction comes out mirrored.

parameters.name: geometry_file
parameters.label: Geometry Vectors File
parameters.description: Text file with one row of 12 numbers per projection: source position, detector centre, detector u step (across the rotation axis) and v step (along it), as in ASTRA's cone_vec geometry.

parameters.name: short_scan
parameters.label: Short-Scan Weights
parameters.description: Parker weights for scans shorter than 360 degrees. Auto uses them when the scan is shorter than a full circle.

parameters.name: volume_size_xy
parameters.label: Volume Size Across the Axis (voxels, 0 = automatic)
parameters.description: Voxels in y and z. 0 covers the field of view.

parameters.name: volume_size_axial
parameters.label: Volume Size Along the Axis (voxels, 0 = automatic)
parameters.description: Voxels in x. 0 covers the field of view.

parameters.name: voxel_size
parameters.label: Voxel Size (0 = automatic)
parameters.description: 0 uses the detector pixel size divided by the magnification.

parameters.name: backend
parameters.label: Compute On
parameters.description: Auto uses a GPU through WebGPU (any vendor) when available and falls back to the CPU.
